Package me.pagar.api

Class PagarmeApiSDKClient

java.lang.Object
me.pagar.api.PagarmeApiSDKClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
Configuration, PagarmeApiSDKClientInterface
public final class PagarmeApiSDKClient extends Object implements PagarmeApiSDKClientInterface
Gateway class for the library. This class acts as a factory for Controllers. It holds the state of the SDK.
